'''Sacorrian grey bears''' were a [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Bear/Legends|bear]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sacorria]]. They had [[Color/Legends|grey]] fur and stood from 2.5 to 3 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall with especially long arms. The bears' appetites were huge and being [[Diet/Legends|omnivores]] they ate anything they could get their hands on, using their [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] and talons to attack prey, which could include sentients. The safest way to deal with a Sacorrian grey bear was to use heavy weaponry or avoid it all together.<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sacorrian grey bears were first mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]] ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying system.
